title: Numeric and string constraints disappear from emitted schemas
instruction: TypeBox-compatible builders enforce string and number constraints locally, but the emitted JSON Schema loses some of them. Downstream validators then accept values that local validation rejects. Preserve the constraints in emitted schemas so both validation paths agree.
acceptance_criteria: Emitted string and number schemas retain the constraints enforced by their builders.
Existing local validation continues to reject values violating those constraints.
